annotations.title: Retrograde ephemeris for a date range

description: Every retrograde-cycle moment of Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune or Pluto between two dates: pre-shadow start, station retrograde, cazimi or opposition, station direct and post-shadow end, each to the UTC minute with the zodiacal degree, as a sorted event list plus the cycles they belong to. Up to 5 years per call; defaults to one year from `from`. Times are UTC, to the minute, from the ephemeris (JPL DE421, 2025–2030). This is astronomical timing, not a horoscope. Paid tool: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base via x402 (HTTP 402 with payment requirements; retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Free tools cover the current status and the next retrograde.

from.description: Range start as YYYY-MM-DD (start of day UTC) or ISO timestamp. Defaults to now.

to.description: Range end as YYYY-MM-DD (end of day UTC) or ISO timestamp. Defaults to one year after `from`.
